workflow_rationale: This is a new feature addition requiring architectural changes to multiple providers. It introduces a new state management pattern (undo/redo stack) and affects the core user workflow across the entire application.

phases.name: Setup and Data Models

subtasks.description: Create AppStateSnapshot model to capture all undoable state (images, groups, colorizedImages, adjustments, selectedGenerations)
subtasks.notes: Created AppStateSnapshot model at lib/models/app_state_snapshot.dart with all required fields (images, groups, colorizedImages, adjustments, selectedGenerations). Updated models.dart barrel file to export the new model.

phases.name: Core Undo/Redo Provider
phases.description: Build the central UndoRedoNotifier that manages history stacks and coordinates state restoration

subtasks.description: Create UndoRedoNotifier StateNotifier with history/future stacks, captureState(), undo(), redo() methods, and 50-state history limit
subtasks.notes:
Created UndoRedoNotifier StateNotifier with:
- History and future stacks for undo/redo operations
- captureState() method to capture current app state before mutations
- undo() method that restores previous state and saves current for redo
- redo() method that restores future state from undo operations
- 50-state history limit (maxHistorySize constant)
- UndoRedoState class with canUndo/canRedo boolean flags
- canUndoProvider and canRedoProvider derived providers for UI
- historyLength and futureLength getters for testing

Also added setStateFromSnapshot() methods to all notifiers for state restoration:
- ImportedImagesNotifier
- GroupsNotifier
- ColorizedImagesNotifier
- AllSelectedGenerationsNotifier
- ImageAdjustmentsNotifier

Committed as fb7a3ae. Note: Verification command (dart analyze) was blocked by environment restrictions; code follows existing patterns and should pass analysis.

subtasks.description: Add UndoRedoNotifier to providers.dart barrel export and implement state restoration logic for all provider types
subtasks.notes: Added export 'undo_redo_provider.dart' to providers.dart barrel file. State restoration logic was already implemented in all provider notifiers during subtask-2-1: ImportedImagesNotifier.setStateFromSnapshot, GroupsNotifier.setStateFromSnapshot, ColorizedImagesNotifier.setStateFromSnapshot, AllSelectedGenerationsNotifier.setStateFromSnapshot, and ImageAdjustmentsNotifier.setStateFromSnapshot. phases.name: Provider Integration
phases.description: Integrate snapshot capture at mutation points in existing providers

subtasks.description: Add captureBeforeMutation() calls to ImportedImagesNotifier methods (removeImage, toggleSelection, clearSelections, markAsGrouped, reset)
subtasks.notes: Added _captureBeforeMutation() calls to ImportedImagesNotifier methods: removeImage, toggleSelection, clearSelections, markAsGrouped, reset. Added Ref parameter to constructor and imported undo_redo_provider.dart.

subtasks.description: Add captureBeforeMutation() calls to GroupsNotifier methods (createGroupFromSelection, removeGroup, renameGroup, updateSku, reset) - note: createGroupFromSelection is cross-cutting
subtasks.notes: Added captureBeforeMutation() calls to all GroupsNotifier mutation methods: createGroupFromSelection (after empty check to avoid unnecessary captures), removeGroup, renameGroup, updateSku, and reset. Follows same pattern as images_provider.dart.

subtasks.description: Add captureBeforeMutation() calls to processing_provider.dart notifiers (ColorizedImagesNotifier, AllSelectedGenerationsNotifier, ImageAdjustmentsNotifier)
subtasks.notes:
Added captureBeforeMutation() calls to processing_provider.dart notifiers:
- ColorizedImagesNotifier: 5 mutation methods (addColorizedImage, updateForGroup, updateForGroupAndGeneration, removeGenerationsForGroup, reset)
- AllSelectedGenerationsNotifier: 1 mutation method (setGeneration)
- ImageAdjustmentsNotifier: 7 mutation methods (setAdjustments, updateHue, updateSaturation, updateBrightness, updateContrast, updateSharpness, reset)
All notifiers now accept Ref parameter and call captureState() before mutations. setStateFromSnapshot methods intentionally don't capture state as they're used for restoring.

phases.name: Export Cancellation
phases.description: Implement cancellable export using CancelableOperation from async package

subtasks.description: Add cancellation support to ExportController with CancelableOperation, isCancelled flag, and cancelExport() method
subtasks.notes:
Added cancellation support to ExportController with:
- CancelableOperation from async package
- _currentExport field and _isCancelled flag
- cancelExport() method to cancel ongoing exports
- isExportingProvider and exportCancelledProvider state providers for UI binding
- Cancellation checks throughout export loops in both exportAll() and exportSingleGeneration()
- ExportCancelledException class for cancelled export operations

Committed as 2bd84a6. Note: Verification command (dart analyze) was blocked by environment restrictions; code follows existing patterns and should pass analysis.

subtasks.description: Add cancellation checks in ExportService.exportDualBackground() loop to stop processing when cancelled and cleanup partial files
subtasks.notes:
Added cancellation checks in ExportService.exportDualBackground() loop:
- Added isCancelled callback parameter to check if export should be cancelled
- Implemented cancellation checks before and after each image processing step (transparent, zoom, front)
- For desktop/mobile: tracks created files and directories for cleanup on cancellation
- Added _cleanupPartialExport() method that deletes partial files and empty directories when export is cancelled
- Updated ExportController to pass isCancelled callback to the service
- For web: cancellation checks prevent further processing but downloaded files cannot be reverted

Committed as 8680532. Note: Verification command (dart analyze) was blocked by environment restrictions; code follows existing patterns.
